description: If a finite context \(\Gamma\) together with the signed context on a finite atom set \(S\) derives \(C\) for every Boolean valuation, then \(\Gamma\) derives \(C\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.derives_cases_finite.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α)
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α))
  (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)
  (h :
    ∀ (v : α → Bool),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Derives
        (Γ ∪ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.signedContext S v) C) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Derives Γ C
